headline: An online retailer needed compliance infrastructure to match its digital storefront.
challenge: E-commerce businesses collect customer and payment data from their first transaction. The corporate, tax and data protection groundwork has to exist before the first sale, not after the first complaint.
delivered: Company incorporation and e-commerce business documentation
Data protection policy drafting for customer and payment information
Business analytics support for sales and customer insights
impact: An online retail business trading on a compliant tax position and a documented data protection framework, with analytics feeding its growth decisions.
